mapper.sql: c.id, c.class_name, c.grade, c.major, c.student_count, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.real_name as teacher_name FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.class_name, c.grade, c.major, c.student_count, c.teacher_id, c.description, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, u.real_name as teacher_name FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.grade, c.class_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_info (class_name, grade, major, student_count, teacher_id, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{className}, #{grade}, #{major}, #{studentCount}, #{teacherId}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
